channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. item.title: Ukrainians Dispute Trump Claim that Starlink is Restored
item.description: President Trump says a Vivek Ramaswamy ad featuring the estranged mom of his democratic opponent is "fair game".  Sources tell CNN the Justice Department is investigating misconduct allegations against Trump ally Corey Lewandowski. Ukrainians dispute that Elon Musk has restored Starlink on battlefield. New York City approves ban on horse-drawn carriage rides. item.title: Will Black Voters Show Up for El-Sayed in Michigan?
item.itunes:title: Will Black Voters Show Up for El-Sayed in Michigan?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Experts say the critical Senate race in Michigan could come down to Black voters in urban areas like Detroit. But is Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed taking this group for granted? Our team travels to Flint to hear from voters about what this outreach looks like. 

--- 

Guest: Jeff Zeleny, CNN Chief National Affairs Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Vivek Ramaswamy's Ohio October Surprise
item.itunes:title: Vivek Ramaswamy's Ohio October Surprise
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A new political ad from Ohio Republican gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy featuring his Democratic opponent’s estranged mom telling voters to reject her has even some Republicans decrying dragging a painful family dynamic into the political arena. But in a close race, could the move sway undecided voters? We examine why Ramswamy is doubling down and how it could impact the race in a key battleground state. 

--- 

Guest: Patrick Svitek, CNN Politics Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
